base_url.correction: No current public listings API base URL; commercial Zoopla data access is available only by arrangement.

auth_type.correction: oauth2 (client-credentials flow with Bearer tokens for currently documented member APIs); the former public listings API has no current authentication scheme because it is no longer publicly available

free_tier_limits.correction: not applicable; there is no publicly available listings API or public free tier

example.correction: No valid current public-listings request exists; the documented property_listings.json API-key example targets a listings API that Zoopla states is no longer publicly available.

description.correction: Zoopla's listings API is no longer publicly available. Organizations with commercial requirements may contact Zoopla to discuss data availability; current public documentation does not establish developer access to listings, valuations, and area statistics as described.

notes: Official current documentation explicitly says the Zoopla listings API is no longer publicly available. The live documentation uses the plural developers.zoopla.co.uk hostname and covers commercial/member and Alto integrations, not the former public API-key property-search service. The base URL's 404 is consistent with this retirement.
